verdict.rationale: Unity's Player/Editor support documented headless/batchmode command-line launch (-batchmode/-nographics, headless mode), and Unity provides both a first-party CLI and Build Automation explicitly for CI pipelines and build agents; independent probe confirms Homebrew-installable CLI with structured output and exit codes for headless CI workers. Missing for 10: no independent third-party report of a full CI pipeline run end-to-end confirming reliability at scale.
